name: email-cli
tagline_zh: 终端里读信、搜信、发信，不用记两套快捷键。Gmail 走 OAuth 令牌，换台机器照样用。
tagline_en: Read, search, send from terminal. Gmail via OAuth works anywhere; macOS Mail via JXA covers iCloud/Outlook/IMAP.
desc_en: Read, search and send the user's email from the terminal via the bundled `email` command, the same commands on every machine. Two backends behind one CLI - the Gmail API with a per-account OAuth token (works from any machine, fast search with Gmail query syntax) and macOS Mail.app over JavaScript for Automation (covers iCloud/Outlook/IMAP accounts, macOS only). why_zh: 两个后端共用一套命令和账户名，切换零成本。Gmail 查询语法直接透传，搜信快过图形界面。
why_en: Two backends, one command set. Gmail query syntax passes through raw; macOS path never touches Keychain beyond Mail scope.
limit_zh: 只认两种后端：Gmail API 和 macOS 邮件（需系统装有 JXA 环境）。
limit_en: Only Gmail API or macOS Mail (JXA). Windows/Linux: Gmail only. iCloud/Outlook need a Mac. Attachments must be local paths; no inline extraction.
title_en: One email command for Gmail & macOS Mail
